## What this is

Independent music label + creator platform: artist site, Label Portal, Blindbandit Mobile social (`/mobile`), free media tools, community/legal pages, and Platform API on production.

## Hosting facts

- Product host: **ChatGPT Sites (OpenAI Sites)** — custom domain mrblindbandit.net
- GitHub Pages: static HTML/CSS/JS mirror only (this repo)
- Auth: Clerk (email + Google; Apple off)
- Realtime: LiveKit (production Worker)
- Data: D1 on Sites (migrations include 0007/0008 in website source)
